integrity: The proof uses explicit commutator coordinates, the two-block alternating Smith form and additive character orthogonality. Standalone standard-library checks corroborate exact small rings, including rings of different characteristics, but finite tests are not universal proofs.
scientific_limitations: The new non-field conclusion requires commutative principal chain rings of length at least two; fields are a previously enumerated boundary. Higher triangular sizes, nonchain local rings and group commutators are excluded. The fixed-target formula is an explicit finite shell sum rather than a simplified table. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: Universal Fourier and fixed-target commutator spectra of triangular matrix algebras over finite chain rings
